content: WIQL: QueryByWiql returns IDs only; >20000 results errors VS402337 (not truncated) unless $top set, which truncates silently. Query text max 32K chars. @CurrentIteration resolves against team context: pass team in route (QueryByWiqlArgs.Team) or @CurrentIteration('[Project]\Team'); without team it uses the project default team. ASOF supports historical membership; DateTime literals without zone use client-local tz; use ISO with Z. timePrecision flag needed for time-of-day comparisons.
